name: spellkave_sense
label: Spellkave Sense
description: Attempt one typed sensing query from spellkave_sense_context. The world freshly selects and authorizes the outcome; a returned query is discovery data, never a success guarantee.

as_body_id.description: Observed non-presence body to act as using frontier.impersonate; the server checks scope and consent.

query_kind.description: Authored sensing query identifier from spellkave_sense_context (for example 'look'). The server authoritatively selects and validates it.

visibility.description: Authored visibility class from spellkave_sense_context (for example 'Local').
